newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Philip Morris rises.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Philip Morris rises.

text.p: Shares in Philip Morris Cos Inc traded higher ahead of Thursday's market opening in response to a Maryland court ruling seen favorable to the tobacco industry, traders said.
Philip Morris, the bellwether for U.S. tobacco stocks, was trading at 45, up from Wednesday's close at 44-1/2, traders said.

Late Wednesday Philip Morris and RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp applauded a Maryland judge's ruling dismissing nine of 13 counts by the state seeking to recover Medicaid expenses from the tobacco industry.
Traders said they had no immediate trades in Mail Boxes Etc after it signed a deal to be acquired by U.S. Office Products Co in a pact worth $276.9 million.

Disk-drive makers were expected to be a feature after Bear Stearns lowered its fiscal 1997 earnings per share estimate on Seagate Technology Inc to $3.45 from $3.55, traders said. Bear Stearns kept a buy rating on Seagate, however.
In pre-opening trades Seagate inched up 1/8 to 43, while Quantum Corp was trading at 38-1/8 up from its close Wednesday at 37-9/16.
